releaseNotes:
• Smooth Cursor Editing: Fixed cursor repositioning in the middle of sentences so editing happens directly at cursor
• Instant 3-4 Word Custom Stickers: Generated directly from what you type in chat with zero extra input boxes
• Lowercase Sinhala Default: Switching from English to Sinhala strictly starts in simple/lowercase mode
• Live Themes Lag Fix & Tilt Physics: Hardware-accelerated ~38 FPS frame limiting eliminates freezing, realistic snow & water physics with speed control
• Updated Numeric & Symbols Keypads: Matches exact 4-row contact dialer and 2-page symbol layout from screenshots
• Instant Update Notifications: Auto-fires rich notification when an update is available
